title: Signature Hardware Observatory — Observatory concept
description: The Signature Hardware Observatory is Manon's original monitoring design: every sensor in the machine presented as an exhibit with its normal range printed beside it. A reading is only half the story; the Observatory always shows the other half — what it should be.

title: Signature Hardware Observatory — Guardian alerts
description: Guardian alerts pair every threshold with a graduated response: warn at 85 C, throttle the workload at 92 C, shut down at 98 C. Each step is announced in plain language before it acts, so protection never feels like a surprise.
